paragraphs.text: Gylwain , also known as the Casting Director , is a Human Bard from Eldraine .
And the pigs called to the wolf, 'WE'LL RIP YOUR CAVE DOWN STONE BY STONE ...

Gylwain appears to be the casting director of a traveling theatre group on Eldraine. He has a horse-drawn kart with colorful tarps along with various costumes for monsters, sorcerers, and royal roles . He wears green pants, a green vest with bells, and a green feathered brown cap. He once performed a play known as the "The Pigs' Revenge".
